note: Metadata only (2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05); no FASTQ bytes fetched. Run titles, infection status and read counts are from the NCBI SRA records of each run; FASTQ URLs and byte sizes are from HTTP HEAD requests to the ENA FTP server; the ENA Portal API returned HTTP 500 for every request while this file was written, so fastq_md5 is null and prepare_dual_public.py reads the MD5 values from the ENA file report at download time and records them. Reference sizes are from HTTP HEAD requests. Nothing here has been run.
acceptance_criteria: Conservation: for every sample, host + pathogen + ambiguous + unassigned equals the reads that entered assignment.
Every mock or healthy sample has a lower pathogen-assigned fraction than every infected sample in the study.
Every sample reaches the host count table, and every infected sample with at least min_assigned_reads pathogen reads reaches the pathogen count table.
Host differential expression completes; pathogen differential expression completes or is reported as not estimable with a reason.
A repeat of the assignment gives identical assignment counts for every sample.
acceptance_note: Written before any run. The criteria follow from the study designs and the route design; none is a numeric threshold. min_assigned_reads is the route default (10000), not a value chosen for these studies.

virus.study_title: Field systems biology of grapevine red blotch reveals the impact of viral infections on the transcriptional and hormonal regulation of berry ripening
virus.design: Zinfandel berries, Oakville vineyard, harvest stage: 3 healthy and 3 GRBaV-positive libraries (6 of the 52 in the study).
virus.protocol_excerpt: Illumina TruSeq RNA Sample Prep Kit v2 protocol
virus.strand_note: TruSeq RNA Sample Prep Kit v2 is listed as unstranded in config/kit_profiles.yaml ("TruSeq RNA v2 (unstranded)").
virus.inference_note: Six of 52 field libraries. The check qualifies the route; it is not a biological result.

downsample.method: none: each verified download is used as it is (0.3 to 0.6 GB per run); a cap could leave too few virus reads to quantify

pathogen.label: GRBV
pathogen.assembly: GCF_000909815.1 (ViralProj214508), NCBI RefSeq, sequence NC_022002.1, 3206 bp
pathogen.gtf_conversion: The RefSeq GTF has gene, CDS, start_codon and stop_codon rows and no exon rows; its gene rows carry an empty transcript_id. The route counts exon rows, so prepare_dual_public.py writes pathogen.exons.gtf with one exon row per gene row (same interval and strand, transcript_id "<gene_id>_tx") and pathogen.transcripts.fa with the matching sequences cut from the genome. These six intervals are the annotated coding regions, not mapped viral transcripts.
pathogen.annotation_note: Six genes on 3206 bp. Several overlap on the same strand (N761_gp6 lies inside N761_gp5), so a read in an overlap may not be counted for either gene on the STAR route.

rejected_candidates.reason: Microvine plantlets, single-end poly(A) RNA-seq with the BioSample attribute treatment set to CONTROL or INFECTED and at least 3 of each. The records carry no library construction protocol or kit name, so strandedness, which a STAR dual-organism project must declare, cannot be established from metadata.
Oxford Nanopore sequencing of the virus (BioProject description); not Illumina host RNA-seq with healthy controls.
Small RNA sequencing; dual-organism small RNA is out of scope.
Small RNA sequencing; dual-organism small RNA is out of scope.
Partial C3 gene sequence reads of the virus only.

cellular.study_title: Transcriptional response of wild-type versus toc1-2 mutant Arabidopsis plants to infection with Botrytis cinerea
cellular.design: Wild-type C24 leaves: 4 mock and 4 Botrytis cinerea infected libraries (8 of the 16 in the study). Each group has two libraries harvested at ZT18 and two at ZT22; the check pools the two harvest times.
cellular.infection_status_source: BioSample attribute "treatment" and the experiment title
cellular.protocol_excerpt: RNA-Seq library was prepared using a TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep kit (Illumina)
cellular.strand_note: TruSeq Stranded mRNA is listed as reverse-stranded in config/kit_profiles.yaml.
cellular.inference_note: Two harvest times are pooled in each group and reads are downsampled. The check qualifies the route; it is not a biological result.

downsample.method: reservoir sampling, pure Python stdlib (no seqtk); the same records are kept for both mates
